notes.title: Climbing Has Never Been This Smooth: Check Out the STRIDE: Fates Update!
notes.content:
Hello Striders,

We’ve got great news for you!

We’ve been working hard to improve STRIDE: Fates and fix a number of issues based on your feedback.

[h3]The STRIDE: Fates update is live now[/h3]

[previewyoutube=0KZNUgiGGLA;full][/previewyoutube]

Here’s a glimpse of what’s new:

-Enhanced weapon interaction mechanics
-Improved hand animations
-Upgraded climbing and grabbing mechanics
-Added new gun skins
-Fixed various bugs

These and many other improvements are waiting for you in the game. 

You can check out the full changelog on our Discord server 👉[url=https://discord.gg/FSbEYSg6bZ ]https://discord.gg/FSbEYSg6bZ [/url]

notes.title: STRIDE: Fates Update v1.16 : Enhancements Across All Platforms
notes.content:
Weapon System Updates:
- Improved magazine insertion system during manual reloading.
- Added the option for automatic magazine drop when bringing a new magazine close.
- Added the ability to holster weapons and magazines.
- Added ghost magazine indication when drawing them.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed situations where hand grips would twist on doors.
- Fixed an issue where objects would disappear in the phone camera.
- Fixed the pause menu movement, where it would rotate incorrectly and pass through the player during a quick turn.
- Fixed a situation where glass would break but not be penetrable by bullets.

Hands:
- Updated the surface detection system for climbing.
- Updated animation system for climbing and using ziplines.
- Improved IK for better elbow movement.
- Added procedural animation for extended surfaces (pipes, ziplines).

Features:
- Added achievements from the PS5 version.
- Added a setting to disable IK.
- Added a setting to disable vignette effects.
- Added a system to adjust weapon tilt in settings.
- Added audio and visual indicators for easier collectible item discovery.
- Added a setting to disable audio indicators for collectible items.
- Added a backup save system for PS5.
- Added the ability to scroll settings with a pointer or stick.
- Added additional saves at the final boss in Slum Jungle.
- Added a start menu with shader loading.
- Added several new weapon skins.
- Added new options to the initial settings menu.
- Added 7 new gun skins (2 SMGs, 1 Shotgun, 4 Pistol)

notes.title: STRIDE: Fates Update v1.15
notes.content:
Replacement of AI-generated graphics with art created by our artists from scratch or using marketplace assets:

-Backgrounds of character cards you see in the hub
-Textures on VHS tape covers
-Textures on book covers
-Textures on banners on building walls

Replacement of AI-generated voices for secondary characters on the Concrete Jungle levels (free DLC #2). From now on, there will be no AI voiceovers left in the game.

notes.title: STRIDE: Fates is live now! - Become a parkour movie hero

We've put in a ton of work over the past few months and want to thank our development team. And of course, a big thank you to you, our players, who have supported us and participated in beta testing 😎

Let's dive into parkour adventures!
